## The four workhorses

- `list` — ordered, mutable.
- `tuple` — ordered, immutable (great as fixed records / dict keys).
- `set` — unique, unordered.
- `dict` — key/value, insertion-ordered since 3.7.

## Idioms

`d.get(k, default)`, `d.setdefault`, membership with `in` (O(1) for set/dict). Unpack with `a, b = pair`.
